com.vector.cfg.automation.scripting.base

Interface IScriptTaskUserDefinedArgumentSpecification<T>

  • Type Parameters:
    T - the value type of the argument.
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IScriptTaskUserDefinedArgument<T>

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IScriptTaskUserDefinedArgumentSpecification<T>
    IScriptTaskUserDefinedArgumentSpecification defines an script user defined argument created during IScriptTask by an IScriptTaskBuilder. This is the specification of a possible argument, the argument itself could not be retrieved by this specification.

    The main use for this, is for code querying information about tasks, to know if the task has possible arguments.
